---
title: "Schedule"
---

One module per meeting is the spine of this course. The reading in a row is
due **before** that class — the ConcepTests only work if you've already met
the ideas once, so the date is the date you show up having read it, not the
date we cover it.

The extra-reading column is optional: nothing on an exam depends on it,
it's there because the topic was too good to cut. Extras are slotted next
to the unit they extend.

Rows marked TBD are real meetings; the reading just isn't posted yet. They
fill in as the semester goes.
